title: Reflex record
description: Each time an instruction is said (a reflex among them), which one, to which run and where (its for place), kept on this pack's own stream; and, read back, how often each was said and whether the misses it answers (refusals of a phrase it names, beats about what it answers) came back in a run after it was said there. Said by the agents pack as it says them (the read said_here); read as said_record, by the reflex_view rows and an agent's query. Split from reflex, which keeps the words.

rules.say: Each instruction said, to which run and where, 90 days of it.

views.description: How often each of some instructions was said, to how many runs and where, and per run whether a miss it answers came back after it was said there (came_back), stopped (held: a miss before, none after) or never showed (quiet). Params: ids (required, at most 50), days (how far back, 30 unless said, 90 at most).
